findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential SSRF via URL fetching
 * @description Fetching URLs without proper validation can lead to SSRF attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssrf-url-fetch
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("parse").getMember(["urlparse", "urljoin"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "URL operation that may be vulnerable to SSRF if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via unvalidated URI/URL fetching in reference resolution
